top_signals.title: Singtel Says ‘Fairly Insulated’ From Nvidia, Raises Guidance
top_signals.summary: Singapore Telecommunications Ltd. said it is largely insulated from developments surrounding Nvidia Corp., with only a small share of its data-center capacity exposed to neocloud customers that may be linked to the chipmaker.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Advent Again Seeks to Sell Singapore Tutor-Chain Learning Lab
top_signals.summary: US buyout firm Advent International Corp. has put up Singapore’s tutor-chain The Learning Lab for sale, marking its second attempt since 2021 to unload the asset, in part to repay debt, according to people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
